name: Focusmate
description: Commercial virtual coworking service that pairs users for scheduled video sessions in which each person states a goal and works on their own tasks.
intended_use: Inspect structured social accountability or 'body doubling' as a practical task-starting environment.
audience_or_context: Adults comfortable working on camera with another service user and able to follow the platform's community rules.
limitations: Sessions require video presence and interaction with another person, which can be inaccessible or poor fit for privacy, sensory, social or safety reasons.
Matching with another user does not make them a professional supporter and does not guarantee task completion.
ND Oracle does not adopt Focusmate's productivity or clinical benefit claims.
cost_or_access_notes: Current free plan allows up to three sessions per week; paid plans provide more sessions and prices can change.
conflicts_of_interest: Focusmate is a commercial subscription service and publishes its own benefit claims; ND Oracle records the service model, current access and conflicts.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
